g.text: One MPI rank; OpenMP threads share its partition.
Threads default to every CPU of the machine.
One MPI rank drives the GPU through CUDA.
Chosen by -d gpu, or detected when -d is omitted.
One rank per socket, OpenMP threads within each.
MPI: shared memory in a node, libfabric between.
threads per rank = node CPUs / ranks per node
Rank n of a node uses GPU n of that node.
MPI between ranks, CUDA on each GPU.
MPI between every rank, OpenMP set to one thread.
Rank n uses GPU n mod G, for G GPUs on the node.
Shown: four ranks on two GPUs.
